race.comment: KING OF LIGHT (3) resumed in the Idyllic Prince and got the job done easily by 1.6L. Been freshened since then and Fiore now takes the ride as he draws out wide. This is tougher than the Idyllic Prince, but he's an exciting prospect for The Pinnacles who can continue to raise the bar. WATCH ME ROCK (2) returns to WA after a disappointing effort in the All Star Mile. His fresh run in the Futurity was sound enough and his two trials since he's returned home have been great. Draws to get every chance on resumption. WESTERN EMPIRE (1) went unbeaten through his last campaign, winning the Strickland Stakes before the break. His two trials have been superb and he was an impressive fresh winner last campaign. Can fire a shot. BONJOY (9) boasts a good fresh record and she won't be far away. ZIPAWAY (10) impressed in his most recent trial and is not to be discounted.
